record.paper_title: Open problems from the 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Set Theory and Its Applications
record.original_question: Let K:R -> [0,1] be a normal generating function for generalized uniform fuzzy partitions of the real line, and assume K satisfies the symmetry condition integral from 1/2-y to y+1/2 of K(x) dx = y for every y in [0,1/2]. For positive real numbers h and r and any central node x_0, consider the scaled generating function (r/h)K used in the quadruple ((r/h)K, h, r, x_0). Is it true that this quadruple determines a generalized uniform fuzzy partition if and only if h/r is a natural number? If not, identify a replacement condition of comparable simplicity under which such an iff criterion holds.

evidence.quote: Problem 7.1 (M. Holcapek, I. Perfilieva, V. Novak and V. Kreinovich). Let K be a normal generating function satisfying the symmetry condition (5). Then, (K_{r/h}, h, r, x0) determines a GUFP iff h/r in N.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. A generalized uniform fuzzy partition (GUFP) of the real line is a system of fuzzy sets on R generated by a quadruple (G, h, r, x_0), where G : R -> [0,1] is a generating function, h > 0 is a bandwidth parameter, r > 0 is a shift parameter, and x_0 ∈ R is a central node. The fuzzy sets of the partition are defined by A_k(x) = G((x - x_k)/h), where x_k = x_0 + k r for k ∈ Z, and the system is required to satisfy the Ruspini-type covering property that the sum Σ_{k ∈ Z} A_k(x) is a positive constant (independent of x ∈ R).

For a function K : R -> [0,1] with support in [-1/2, 1/2] and any λ > 0, define the scaled function K_λ(x) = λ K(λ x).

Assume K : R -> [0,1] is a normal generating function (i.e. its maximum value equals 1 and is attained) satisfying the symmetry condition
   ∫_{1/2 - y}^{y + 1/2} K(x) dx = y    for every y ∈ [0, 1/2].

Question. For positive real numbers h, r and any central node x_0 ∈ R, is it true that the quadruple (K_{r/h}, h, r, x_0) determines a generalized uniform fuzzy partition of R if and only if h/r ∈ N? If this characterization fails, find a replacement condition of comparable simplicity on the parameters (h, r) (and possibly on K) under which an "if and only if" criterion of the same form holds.
artifact.status_search_result: Holčapek, Perfilieva, Novák and Kreinovich have published work on necessary and sufficient conditions for generalized uniform fuzzy partitions (Fuzzy Sets and Systems, 2015). It is not clearly verifiable from the available search results whether this specific iff conjecture (h/r ∈ N under the stated symmetry condition) has been confirmed, refuted, or replaced; status is therefore unknown.

status_evidence.title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for generalized uniform fuzzy partitions
status_evidence.snippet: Holčapek, Perfilieva et al. give conditions for when a generating function induces a generalized uniform fuzzy partition.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related published work exists but does not clearly resolve the stated iff conjecture.
